0022600091.text: Both the Dallas Mavericks and Houston Rockets open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, which is the Mavericks' first of the year and sees them play at Houston. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Jett Howard (illness), Max Christie (rest), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), all listed as day-to-day, while Houston is without Steven Adams (rest), also day-to-day. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and their last meeting was on January 31, 2026, in Houston, where the Mavericks lost 111-107. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Dallas a 30% chance to win.
